title: Daphne chefs serving up help to Texas with fundraising take home meals - NewsBreak
text: DAPHNE, Ala. ( WKRG ) — A pair of Daphne chefs are putting their talents to a good cause, raising money for the Kerr County Flood Relief Fund through take-home pasta meals and homemade bread. Capers in the Kitchen features the culinary creations of chefs Pam Hunter and Kris Conlon, and routinely gives to charities across the Gulf Coast region, according to the website . This week, they are turning their attention – and talents – to those ravaged by the floods in Texas. “Yesterday we served over 100 plates of hot penne pasta with fresh made bread as a fundraiser for the Kerr County Flood Relief,” Hunter said. “Today we still wanted to do more and decided to take our most popular dish, Beef Lasagna, and continue to help our Texas neighbors.” According to a Capers in the Kitchen Facebook post , anyone who orders the take and bake beef lasagna with bechamel sauce will contribute to the fundraiser. The dish is $40 and serves 5. Also available is a loaf of the housemade rustic bread, one of Conlon’s specialties, for $5. “Our lasagna orders and orders for our rustic bread earmarked for this cause are amazing so far,” she said on Wednesday. Preorders can be texted to Hunter at 251-454-0812, and orders can be picked up Thursday between 10 a.m. and 1 p.m. or Friday between 10 a.m. and 5 p.m. at the Knights of Columbus, 602 Main Street in Daphne. All of the proceeds will go to the Kerr County Flood Relief Fund, a 501(c)(3) public charity that serves the Texas Hill Country communities of Hunt, Ingram, Kerrville, Center Point and Comfort. The organization distributes funds raised to “vetted organizations providing rescue, relief and recovery efforts, as well as flood assistance,” according to the Capers in the Kitchen Facebook post. The post said the organization gives funds to nonprofit organizations, first responder agencies and local governments directly involved in response, relief and recovery efforts. It does not give money to individuals or directly pay for personal repairs or property replacement, but supports those efforts through the agencies it does help. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WKRG News 5.
